name: games.hocus/hocus-games
title: Hocus Games
description: Find browser games by verified facts (devices, sign-up, ads, multiplayer, genre) and play links.

tools.name: search_games
tools.description: Find browser games by player preferences. Returns at most 10 (default 3) ranked games with direct play links, match reasons and evidence labels. Strict filters never accept unknown facts; check "shortage" when fewer games match than requested.

query.description: Free-text preference, e.g. "relaxing space puzzle". Matched against title, genres, themes, keywords and description.

genres.description: Match games having ANY of these genres.

subgenres.description: Match games having ANY of these sub-genres (the distributor's finer categories, e.g. hidden-object, match-3, tower-defense, jigsaw-puzzles).

art_styles.description: Match games having ANY of these graphics styles (pixel = retro/pixel art, vector = flat/minimalist, hand_drawn = artsy/painterly). Inferred from screenshots.

themes.description: Match games having ANY of these themes (setting/subject, e.g. fantasy = fantasy/epic, sci_fi = sci-fi/space, war = war/military, ocean = sea/pirates).

tones.description: Match games having ANY of these tones/moods (funny, cute = cute/cozy, relaxing, scary, intense = intense/competitive, serious = serious/realistic...).

player_modes.description: Game must support ALL of these modes. "same_device_multiplayer" = local multiplayer on one device.

devices.description: Game must work on ALL of these devices. Use ["mobile"] for "works on my phone".

inputs.description: Game must support ALL of these input methods.

no_signup.description: true = only games known to be playable without creating an account.

no_download.description: true = only games known to play in the browser without a download/install.

offline_play.description: true = only games known to work offline after loading.

free_to_start.description: true = only games known to be free or free to start.

no_ads.description: true = only games known to show no ads.

session_length.description: short = a session fits in ~5 minutes; medium = 5–20; long = 20+.

publisher.description: Only games listed under this publisher id (as returned in a game's publisher.id).

pace.description: relaxed = "take your time": no clock or opponent rushing you (most puzzles, turn-based, solitaire-like); timed = reflexes or speed decide (arcade, real-time).

min_graphics_polish.description: Only games whose graphics polish score is known and at least this (0–5; 3 = decent, consistent style; 4 = polished; 5 = outstanding). Scores are inferred from screenshots.

min_rating.description: Only games whose average player rating (1-5 stars, one decimal) is at least this. Games with fewer than 3 ratings have no public rating and never match. Ratings are player opinions, not verified facts.

min_evidence.description: Weakest evidence accepted for filtered facts: inferred (default) < declared (by developer) < tested (by us).

include_unknown.description: true = also return games whose filtered facts are UNKNOWN, as a separate labelled list. They never count as matches.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

tools.name: get_game_details
tools.description: Return the authoritative public catalog record for one game id from search_games: every fact with its evidence method, source and date (or "unknown"), developer attribution, link status and play URL, plus `related`: up to 8 similar games (shared genre, sub-genre, style, theme and tone, later also what the same people play), each with the reasons.

tools.name: start_sign_up
tools.description: Start an optional Hocus Games account for a person who asked for it, with ONLY their email address and, optionally, the genres, graphics styles, themes and tones they want to hear about. We email them a confirmation link; they confirm, choose their password and accept the Terms of Service on the Hocus Games website; the account picks games for them from what they do on the site (they can turn that off on their account page) (never pass or ask for a password here). Once confirmed they get a weekly email listing newly published games with ANY of the chosen tags (only when there is at least one), and they can rate games on the website. The answer is the same whether or not the address already has an account. Playing games never needs an account. Rating games through MCP is not available (it would need MCP sign-in, OAuth, which this server does not offer yet).

email.description: The person's own email address, given by them for this purpose.

follow.description: Tags to follow for the weekly email; the same values search_games uses for these filters.

tools.name: check_game_url
tools.description: For game developers: test the link of a browser game against Hocus Games' submission requirements, without submitting. Reports problems that would stop a submission (not https, page not loading, robots.txt blocking HocusGamesBot, already listed or submitted) and advice (whether the game can play inside Hocus Games or only be linked, and how to allow it; a missing phone viewport tag). Run it before submit_game and help the developer fix what it flags.

game_url.description: The https page where the game plays.

tools.name: submit_game
tools.description: For game developers: submit a browser game to be listed on Hocus Games. Games made with AI are welcome and reviewed like any other. Requires: an https link where the game plays (no download), title, a plain description, developer name, the developer's own contact email, honest answers about ads and purchases, a square icon (icon_url; 512x512 recommended, 256x256 minimum) and 3-8 screenshots of actual gameplay (screenshot_urls; not title screens or logos), images as https links to PNG, JPEG or WebP files, and confirm_rights:true only if the person said they made the game or may submit it. Optional facts (genres, devices, inputs, player modes, orientation, sign-up) are shown as "declared by the developer". We email the contact a confirmation link (48 hours); a person reviews the game only after that, and emails the decision. Every problem is returned at once, so fix them all and submit again. Returns the submission id and a status_token for get_submission_status.

game_url.description: The page where the game plays in a browser, https://. No download, no app store.

description.description: What the game is and how it plays, in 1-4 plain sentences (30-600 characters). No marketing superlatives.

developer_name.description: Developer or studio name, shown on the listing.

contact_email.description: The developer's own email for this submission: we send the confirmation link and our decision there. Never shown publicly.

has_purchases.description: Does the game sell anything (in-game purchases, paid unlocks)?

signup_required.description: Must players create an account to play?

devices.description: Devices the game is made to work on.

made_with_ai.description: Optional: was the game made with AI tools? Never counts against a game.

ai_tools.description: Optional: which AI tools or models helped.

notes.description: Optional note for the reviewer (controls, what to try first).

confirm_rights.description: The submitter made this game or is allowed to submit it, and the screenshots show actual gameplay. Only true if the person said so.

icon_url.description: https link to a square PNG/JPEG/WebP icon, 512x512 recommended, at least 256x256.

screenshot_urls.description: 3-8 https links to screenshots of actual gameplay, each at least 640x360.

tools.name: get_submission_status
tools.description: Status of a game submitted with submit_game: waiting for email confirmation, waiting for review, accepted (with the listing link) or declined (with the reviewer's note).
